reader_summary.overview: Acquired kicks off Season 3 with a gangbuster two-hour extravaganza on America’s most successful automotive startup since The Ford Motor Company: Tesla. We cover everything, from founding to its 2010 IPO to all that’s happened since, including the question on the minds of superhero fans everywhere. (Spoiler: Elon) Sponsors: Legora: Vanta: ServiceNow: Statsig: More Acquired!
